import os, sys, time, torch, math
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load
SRC='/root/hk_src'
assert os.path.exists(SRC+'/hkernel.cu')
os.makedirs(SRC+'/bs', exist_ok=True)
t0=time.time()
mod = load(name='hk_st', sources=[SRC+'/hkernel.cu', SRC+'/hbind.cpp'], extra_cuda_cflags=['-O3','--use_fast_math','-std=c++17','-gencode=arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a','-DH_STAMPS'], extra_ldflags=['-lcuda'], build_directory=SRC+'/bs')
print('build', round(time.time()-t0,1), flush=True)
def gen(B,C,H,W,seed):
    g=torch.Generator(device='cuda').manual_seed(seed)
    r=lambda *s: torch.randn(*s, device='cuda', generator=g)
    x=r(B,C,H,W); dw=r(C,1,7,7)/math.sqrt(7); dwb=r(C); lnw=torch.ones(C,device='cuda'); lnb=torch.zeros(C,device='cuda')
    w1=r(4*C,C)/math.sqrt(C); b1=r(4*C); gw=r(1,1,1,4*C)/math.sqrt(4*C); gb=r(1,1,1,4*C); w2=r(C,4*C)/math.sqrt(4*C); b2=r(C)
    return [x,dw,dwb,lnw,lnb,w1,b1,gw,gb,w2,b2,1e-6,1e-6]
flush=torch.empty(64*1024*1024, device='cuda')
for (B,C,H,W) in [(8,768,7,7),(32,768,7,7),(16,384,14,14)]:
    inp=gen(B,C,H,W,200); out=torch.zeros(B,C,H,W,device='cuda')
    st=torch.zeros(4096*4, dtype=torch.int64, device='cuda')
    for rep in range(3):
        flush.zero_(); st.zero_(); torch.cuda.synchronize()
        mod.run(*inp,out,st); torch.cuda.synchronize()
    s=st.view(-1,4).cpu().double()
    n=int((s[:,3]>0).sum()) + 1
    # item layout
    nW=148; MT1=4*C//128; MT2=C//128
    if C==768: PG = 32 if B<=8 else (64 if B<=16 else 128); IPT1=2; NTS=1; KS2=4; IPT2=2
    else: PG=32; IPT1=1; NTS=2; KS2=2; IPT2=1
    NG=C//PG; nConv=B*NG; nG1=(B//IPT1)*MT1; nG2=(B//IPT2)*NTS*MT2*KS2
    o=[0,nW,nW+nConv,2*nW+nConv,2*nW+nConv+nG1,2*nW+nConv+nG1+nG2]
    s=s[:o[5]]
    t0=s[:,0].min()
    s[:,:3]=(s[:,:3]-t0)/1000.0
    print(f'== {B},{C},{H}  span(last end) {s[:,2].max():.1f} us  items {o[5]}')
    names=['W1','conv','W2','G1','G2']
    for k in range(5):
        a=s[o[k]:o[k+1]]
        if len(a)==0: continue
        start=a[:,0]; dep=a[:,1]; end=a[:,2]
        dur=end-start
        if k>=3: wait=dep-start; work=end-dep
        else: wait=torch.zeros_like(dur); work=dur
        print(f'{names[k]:5s} n={len(a):4d} start[min/med/max] {start.min():6.1f}/{start.median():6.1f}/{start.max():6.1f} end[min/med/max] {end.min():6.1f}/{end.median():6.1f}/{end.max():6.1f}  work med {work.median():5.2f} max {work.max():5.2f} wait med {wait.median():5.2f} max {wait.max():5.2f}  sumwork {work.sum():7.1f} sumwait {wait.sum():6.1f}')
    # per-CTA idle: gaps between items
    cta=s[:,3].long()
    gaps=[]
    for c in range(148):
        m=s[cta==c]
        if len(m)==0: continue
        m=m[m[:,0].argsort()]
        g=(m[1:,0]-m[:-1,2]).sum().item(); gaps.append(g)
    print(f'inter-item gap per CTA mean {sum(gaps)/len(gaps):.2f} us; per-CTA last end min {min([s[cta==c][:,2].max().item() for c in range(148)]):.1f}')
args.note: H v1 stamps per item type

import os, sys, time, torch, math
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load
SRC='/root/hk_src'
assert os.path.exists(SRC+'/hk3.cu')
os.makedirs(SRC+'/hk3k', exist_ok=True)
m = load(name='hk3k', sources=[SRC+'/hk3.cu', SRC+'/hbind.cpp'], extra_cuda_cflags=['-O3','--use_fast_math','-std=c++17','-gencode=arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a','-DH_KS2=2'], extra_ldflags=['-lcuda'], build_directory=SRC+'/hk3k')
def ref(x,dw,dwb,lnw,lnb,w1,b1,gw,gb,w2,b2,eps,lneps):
    x,dw,dwb,lnw,lnb,w1,b1,gw,gb,w2,b2=[t.double() for t in (x,dw,dwb,lnw,lnb,w1,b1,gw,gb,w2,b2)]
    C=x.shape[1]; d=F.conv2d(x,dw,dwb,padding=3,groups=C).permute(0,2,3,1)
    a=F.layer_norm(d,(C,),lnw,lnb,lneps); h=F.gelu(a@w1.T+b1)
    gx=torch.norm(h,p=2,dim=(1,2),keepdim=True); nx=gx/(gx.mean(dim=-1,keepdim=True)+eps)
    h=gw*(h*nx)+gb+h; y=h@w2.T+b2
    return x+y.permute(0,3,1,2)
empty=torch.empty(0,device='cuda')
for (B,C,H,W,atol) in [(8,768,7,7,2.9e-3),(16,768,7,7,2.9e-3),(32,768,7,7,2.9e-3),(8,384,14,14,2.8e-3),(16,384,14,14,3.3e-3)]:
    torch.manual_seed(200); mx=0.0; nb=0
    for rnd in range(10):
        r=lambda *s: torch.randn(*s, device='cuda')
        x=r(B,C,H,W); dw=r(C,1,7,7)/math.sqrt(7); dwb=r(C); lnw=torch.ones(C,device='cuda'); lnb=torch.zeros(C,device='cuda')
        w1=r(4*C,C)/math.sqrt(C); b1=r(4*C); gw=r(1,1,1,4*C)/math.sqrt(4*C); gb=r(1,1,1,4*C); w2=r(C,4*C)/math.sqrt(4*C); b2=r(C)
        inp=[x,dw,dwb,lnw,lnb,w1,b1,gw,gb,w2,b2,1e-6,1e-6]
        out=torch.zeros(B,C,H,W,device='cuda'); m.run(*inp,out,empty); torch.cuda.synchronize()
        rf=ref(*inp); err=(out.double()-rf).abs()
        mx=max(mx, err.max().item()); nb+=(err>atol+1e-5*rf.abs()).sum().item()
    print(f'PRECISION {B},{C},{H}: max|err| {mx:.3e} vs atol {atol:.1e} ({100*mx/atol:.0f}%), beyond {nb} over 10 rounds', flush=True)
args.note: precision log, 10 seeded rounds, fp64 ref, shipped config (KS2=2)
